_comment: Canonical registry of field types and widget names understood by all three stacks (Go, Python, TypeScript). A record template section references one of these 'type' values. Widget names match component identifiers in the frontend.

mental_exam.description: 10-domain mental-status checklist; each domain has {status: NORMAL|ALTERED, note: string}
mental_exam.ai_schema: {appearance:{status,note}, consciousness_orientation:{status,note}, attention:{status,note}, memory:{status,note}, language:{status,note}, thought:{status,note}, affect:{status,note}, perception:{status,note}, judgment:{status,note}, insight:{status,note}}

formulation_5f.description: 5-factor clinical formulation (presenting, predisposing, precipitating, perpetuating, protective)

functional_analysis.description: Functional (ABC) analysis of a target behavior

distress_scale.description: Subjective Units of Distress 0–10 with anchor labels

task_checklist.description: Checklist of therapeutic tasks for the session

task_adherence.description: Between-session homework review with adherence rating

session_evaluation.description: Professional evaluation of the session (axis, quality, notes)

functionality.description: Global assessment of patient functional level (work, social, personal)

risk.description: Risk assessment widget — writes the system risk_level field (NONE|IDEATION|PLAN|ATTEMPT)
risk.ai_schema: one of: NONE, IDEATION, PLAN, ATTEMPT

diagnoses.description: ICD-10 diagnoses panel (suggested only; professional confirms before saving)
